faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Assistant Project Engineer position at IIT Guwahati is 22nd August 2026. Ensure your application is completed before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication or Telecommunication Engineering with a minimum of 60 percent marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Project Engineer position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 34,310.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer role at IIT Guwahati will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Project Engineer post in this recruitment drive by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Project Engineer position at IIT Guwahati is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is https://iitg.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITG/II&S/I/Project Staff Rectt-2026/141.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam.
